dublin_core_group.title: 2021 Miami-Dade NLCD Tree Cover v2023-5
dublin_core_group.license_text:
These data were collected using funding from the U.S. Government and can be used without additional permissions or fees. If you use these data in a publication, presentation, or other research product please use the following citation:
USDA Forest Service. 2023. USFS NLCD Percent Tree Canopy CONUS v2021-4. Sioux Falls, SD.
dublin_core_group.description: NLCD tree canopy cover is a 30 m raster geospatial dataset that is available for the conterminous United States. They are generated by the USDA Forest Service. These data contain percent tree canopy estimates, as a continuous variable, for each pixel across all land covers and types. Tree canopy cover is derived from multi-spectral satellite imagery and other available ground and ancillary information.

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/download -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# load us_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5 as dependency (see us_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5 for details).

# clip raster with geometry as:
  gdalwarp -cutline PG:"<postgres connection>" -csql "SELECT geom FROM fl_2022_tl_cousub WHERE countyfp='086'" -crop_to_cutline -s_srs EPSG:5070 -t_srs EPSG:4326 /data/us_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/download/nlcd_tcc_conus_wgs84_v2023-5_20210101_20211231.tif download/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5.tif
 
#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# load raster into postGIS with:
    raster2pgsql -s 4326 -d -C -I -t 48x48 mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5.tif -F mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5 > load_raster.sql
psql <connection options> < load_raster.sql
rm load_raster.sql

# create color raster
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5
cat > /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5_color_ramp.txt <<_EOF
nv 0 0 0 0
255 255 255 255 0
100 0 68 27 255
90 0 109 44 255
80 29 134 65 255
70 53 159 84 255
60 85 181 103 255
50 123 199 124 255
40 158 215 152 255
30 187 228 181 255
20 213 239 207 255
10 233 247 229 255
0 255 255 255 0
_EOF
gdaldem color-relief download/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5.tif /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5_color_ramp.txt /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5_color.tif -alpha
# create color raster and render raster tiles 
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5
echo "" | base64 -d > /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5_legend.png
cp /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5_legend.png /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/
# render raster tiles 
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/
gdal2tiles.py -ex --xyz -z 8-16 /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5_color.tif /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_tcc_v2023_5
